# Navimower Map Card 0.3.0-beta6

## Home Assistant visual-editor hotfix

Fixes the error shown when opening an existing Navimower Map Card or creating a new one:

`Cannot assign to read only property 'type' of object '#<Object>'`

The beta5 color normalization wrapper now treats the configuration supplied by Home Assistant as immutable. It passes a normalized copy to the card core instead of writing back into Home Assistant's frozen object.

## Compatibility

- Existing YAML keys and saved card configurations remain unchanged.
- Synchronized color picker and manual HEX inputs remain enabled.
- Schedule save confirmation behavior remains unchanged.
- Both source and HACS distribution files include the fix.
- Recommended backend remains Navimower integration `0.4.0-beta2` or later.

## Testing requested

After updating through HACS, verify that both an existing card and a newly created card open in the visual editor without the read-only `type` error. Also verify that color changes through either the picker or HEX field still update and save normally.
